About the Plaza

Pennock Professional Plaza is a well-kept two-story office building on N. Pennock Lane in Jupiter, just off W. Indiantown Road. The building is home to a mix of tenants — local businesses, medical, and wellness practices — sharing on-site parking, secure building access, and a quiet, professional setting.

Directly across the street from a shopping and dining plaza, it's an easy walk for a coffee run, lunch, or a casual client meeting between appointments.
